spec.instruction: Famous professional athletes with a single well-established main sport and playing position. Mix association football (answer soccer), American football (answer football), basketball, baseball, ice hockey, rugby, cricket, volleyball. No individual sports without playing positions. Include women and non-US athletes. Prefer retired players. Plain conventional position names; no handedness modifiers.
